base_packet: Exact 64-byte native summary packet and 128-byte command/reply ABI from summary_hbm_schema_v1; original endpoint is unchanged.
subscriber_identity: Bit worker*8+lane in a u64. Only nonowner members of immutable full membership may subscribe; lane<lanes, with lanes<=8 and dies<=8.
atomic_subscribe: With reply credit, read current owner and register the observer in one serial owner operation. If owner is absent, return missing and create no subscription. A late subscriber receives the current value and does not retroactively acquire a pending bit.
owner_install: Check expected previous version and increasing value version. A successful change ORs all current subscriber bits into pending. Enqueue the slot only if it was not already pending. Reject exhausted queue tickets before mutating owner/registry state.
registry: Per-slot 64B words: session,subscribers,pending,queued_boolean,0,0,0,0. Pending is a subset of subscribers; queued iff pending is nonzero. Owner records use the existing summary ABI.
dirty_queue: Unique pending slot IDs in a power-of-two u32 ring with capacity>=slot count; read/write tickets never wrap. Control words: session,read,write,0,0,0,0,0. Session increases lazily invalidate old records and reset the dirty queue.
publication: Process commands, then at most the starting dirty-entry count (and the explicit visit/output budgets). Emit eligible pending subscribers in increasing bit order from the head slot. Coalesce intervening installations to the latest owner tuple. Rotate entries with only unselected subscribers exactly once per pass; retain those pending bits. Remove the head only when no pending bit remains.
update_record: 128B: kind-3 summary packet followed by u64 lane,slot,version,0,0,0,0,0. Packet serial=owner update producer ticket+1. CPU replay dispatch sorts by worker/node and rewrites only the transport serial to compare against the prior native receiver envelope; the generated value is unchanged and independently checked.
credit: No reply credit means no command consumption or state mutation by that command. No update credit means no eligible pending bit is cleared. A full update queue does not prevent further owner installations if command/reply credits exist; latest versions coalesce in the pending slot.
completion: 64B words: new_command_read,new_response_write,new_update_write,commands_consumed,updates_emitted,queue_visits,error,session. Error 1=invalid launch/control, 2=invalid queued slot/record, 3=dirty rotation ticket exhaustion. Commands already completed before a pump error remain completed; caller must retain the returned cursors.
interfaces: Five AXI masters: traffic(commands/replies/completion), index(topology/dirty queue/control), owner_state, subscriptions, publications. They use explicit buffer ownership handoff between launches. The first seven-master version passed RTL but exceeded the joint platform master-port budget.
event_capture: FPGAACCP header, type 0x44520025, 384B records. Metadata u64 repeat,source_frame,actor,reason,die,event_kind,call_id,ordinal. Kind0 payload=command,descriptor,reply,receipt,completion. Kind1=filter/budgets/cursors config,control_before,control_after,completion,zero. Kind2=update_packet,update_metadata,zero,zero,zero; follows its pump with the same call ID.
scope: Hardware subscription and changed-only owner publisher. CPU still supplies committed owner tuples and dispatches output records; receiver and whole-net commit are separate. Real replay consumes previously audited search commands; online native integration is still required.
not_proven: Crash atomicity during a kernel invocation
Concurrent host DMA while a CU owns writable buffers
Full hardware search and whole-net commit
Fresh native routing with this publisher until live-backend tests are completed
